name: @kiwa-lab/lean
description: Lean 4 spec generator for lifecycle-orchestrator state machines. Compiles a transition table to a Lean 4 inductive type and a total dispatch function with no catch-all, so Lean’s exhaustiveness checker is what proves the table is complete, and a rejected transition is distinguishable from a deliberate self-loop. Emits absorbing and has-exit theorems that fail to compile when the table contradicts them, and runs the real toolchain via verifyLeanSpec.

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/**/*.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/src/index.js' && node ../../scripts/record-artifact-inputs.mjs coverage
